messages:
olivia (partnerships): Quick sync 1: CloudCatalog listing needs final security artifacts for marketplace review: SOC2 cover, pen-test summary, and partner questionnaire. Can someone own collection + redaction validation?
jamal (security): I can own the security side. Need to know upload path + default presign TTL. Also we should agree redaction rules.
maya (legal): We will only permit SOC2 Type II public summaries. Full reports require an NDA. Also must redact customer identifiers and PII per policy.
rachel (si-partner): We have SOC2 summary and a redacted pentest PDF. We need a checklist for what to redact and the upload S3 location.
sam (infra): Use s3://redwood-catalog-evidence/marketplace/si-acme/YYYY-MM-DD/. Default presign: 14 days (1209600s). If you need shorter, request expires-in seconds.
jamal (security): Redaction checklist (short): replace internal hostnames with HOST_REDACTED, remove external customer IPs, redact IAM principal ARNs and account numbers, strip full log dumps and stack traces, remove any encryption keys.
maya (legal): Add: remove names/emails unless partner-permitted, and redact employee IDs. I'll circulate the formal redaction doc after Jamal's short list.
olivia (partnerships): Timeline: artifacts by Tue EOD to meet Wed marketplace intake. Announcement planned Fri. Can the partner meet Tue?
rachel (si-partner): Tue EOD is fine. We'll upload redacted files and mark one contact. Who verifies redactions?
jamal (security): I'll do a quick verification Wed AM. If anything fails, I'll flag for legal review.
sam (infra): Presign example (owner run):
```
aws s3 presign s3://redwood-catalog-evidence/marketplace/si-acme/2026-03-25/pen-test-redacted.pdf --expires-in 1209600
```
To shorten TTL use --expires-in 86400 for 1 day.
olivia (partnerships): For the marketplace intake form we need a partner owner name for contacts and evidence. Who should I list?
rachel (si-partner): Put "rachel (si-partner)" as partner evidence owner, and "jamal (security)" as internal verifier. I'll cc our compliance ops.
maya (legal): If partner wants to share a full report we'll route NDA via DocuSign to rachel@si-acme.com. Please note the audit scope requirement.
jamal (security): Action items: 1) Rachel uploads SOC2 summary + redacted pen-test to specified s3 path by Tue EOD. 2) Sam presigns links (14d) and posts them in intake. 3) Jamal verifies redactions Wed AM. 4) Maya does legal sign-off if any PII/PII-ish content remains.
olivia (partnerships): I'll update the intake form with owners and attach the announcement checklist. Thanks all :tada:
security-bot: Reminder: attach ticket #MC-4789 to the evidence upload or marketplace intake will reject the submission.
